node.title: Re: Selecting Ranges of 2-Dimensional Data
node.author: LanX
node.doctext:
FWIW:

it's possible to alias single array elements use warnings; use strict; use Data::Dump qw/pp/; my @a= ('a','b','c','d'); *b = \$a[1]; $b ="X"; pp @a

("a", "X", "c", "d")

But wasn't able yet to bind the alias to another array element.

But I seem to remember seeing it done in the past ...°

Cheers Rolf
(addicted to the Perl Programming Language :)
